title: Sensor Installation and Monitoring Standards for FloodPay Locations
content:
Every FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines) policy rests on a depth sensor that Tidemark installs at the insured location. This standard sets, per tier, where the sensor's zero point sits, how long Tidemark has to install it after binding, what happens to a policy whose sensor is never installed, how long a sensor may go without reporting before cover is suspended, and Tidemark's repair target for a faulty sensor.

| Tier | Sensor zero point above the lowest finished floor (inches) | Installation window after binding (calendar days) | Never-installed policy cancelled flat with full return of premium | Hours without a sensor report after which cover is suspended (elapsed hours) | Repair or replacement target for a faulty sensor (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 0 | 45 | Yes | 48 | 5 |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 0 | 45 | Yes | 48 | 5 |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 0 | 45 | Yes | 48 | 5 |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 0 | 45 | Yes | 48 | 5 |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 0 | 45 | Yes | 48 | 5 |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 0 | 45 | Yes | 48 | 5 |

## The standard in words

1. **Mounting height.** On every tier the sensor's zero point is set 0 inches above the location's lowest finished floor — that is, level with the lowest finished floor.
2. **Installation window.** The sensor must be installed within 45 calendar days after binding, or the policy is cancelled flat.
3. **Flat cancellation of a never-installed policy.** On every tier a policy whose sensor was never installed is cancelled with full return of premium.
4. **Fault threshold.** Cover is suspended after 48 elapsed hours without a sensor report.
5. **Repair target.** Tidemark's target for repairing or replacing a faulty sensor is 5 business days.

## Units at a glance

| Quantity | Unit | Figure on every tier |
|---|---|---|
| Zero point height | inches above the lowest finished floor | 0 |
| Installation window | calendar days after binding | 45 |
| Fault threshold | elapsed hours without a report | 48 |
| Repair target | business days | 5 |
